raw.query: SELECT b.sm_clock_mhz AS unlocked_clk, m.sm_clock_mhz AS locked_clk FROM collector_bench_run b, collector_bench_run m WHERE b.source_path LIKE '%burst_anchor_all%' AND m.source_path LIKE '%anchor_master%' AND b.is_valid=true AND m.is_valid=true
raw.observed: unlocked_clk=2887 MHz, locked_clk=2400 MHz; ratio 2887/2400≈1.203 (≈20.3% faster)
raw.evidence: Two collections at different clock states exist but the SM clock ratio derivable from collector_bench_run is 2887/2400≈20.3%, not ~17%, and no stored ratio in any table or view computes exactly 1.17
raw.fix: Change '≈17%' to '≈20%' to match the SM clock ratio, or store the explicit per-kernel unlocked/locked geomean ratio as a computed metric if the 17% derives from a weighted average at a different effective unlocked clock.
